messages.subject: Legend
parts:
GGPLOT2,

I was wondering if there is a way to group together in the legend the coloring and shape of points to make the points distinguisable in two methods (color and shape).  When I successfully did both, it showed two legends instead of one.  Is there a way to have only one?

Here is a copy of the code

Bias <- rbind(
   data.frame(s = qF, F = sumBias[,1], fun = 'Bias of F unweighted'),
   data.frame(s = qG, F = sumBias[,2], fun = 'Bias of G unweighted'),
   data.frame(s = qF, F = sumBias[,3], fun = 'Bias of F weighted'),
   data.frame(s = qG, F = sumBias[,4], fun = 'Bias of G weighted'),
   data.frame(s = qF, F = sumBias[,5], fun = 'Bias of F KM'),
   data.frame(s = qG, F = sumBias[,6], fun = 'Bias of G KM')
   )
bias <- qplot(s, F, data = Bias, geom = 'point',
   group = fun, colour = fun, shape = fun, size = I(1.5), main = 'Bias of Exponential') +
   ylab('Bias') + xlab('Quantiles') +
   scale_colour_discrete('Bias')


Thanks,

--
Luciano Rodriguez

messages.author: 6d91a9061453aa7b
messages.subject: Re: Legend
parts:
I'm guessing that the colour legend has the label 'Bias' while the
shape legend says 'fun'. In order to combine them the two labels need
to be the same. i.e.

bias <- qplot(s, F, data = Bias, geom = 'point',
group = fun, colour = fun, shape = fun, size = I(1.5), main = 'Bias
of Exponential') +
ylab('Bias') + xlab('Quantiles') +

scale_colour_discrete('Bias') +
scale_shape_discrete('Bias')

A simpler example:

a<-rep(1:3,each=3)
b<-runif(9)
c<-factor(rep(1:3,3))
d<-data.frame(a,b,c)
p<-ggplot(d)+aes(x=a,y=b,group=c,shape=c,colour=c)+geom_point()
p+scale_colour_discrete(name='testlabel_c')
p+scale_shape_discrete(name='testlabel_s')
p+scale_colour_discrete('label')+scale_shape_discrete('label')

I prefer to handle legend labels with the rest of my labels using opts.

p+opts(labels=c(colour='label',shape='label'))

Faisal
